description_en: Modifies the configurations for log delivery to Simple Log Service (SLS)
name: ModifySlsDispatchConfig

parameters.help_en:
The modification type. Valid values:

version: The version is changed. For example, the version is changed from 1 (logs are delivered to one Logstore) to 2 (logs are delivered to two Logstores).

config: The configuration is changed. For example, the log delivery region or the storage duration of logs is modified
parameters.help_zh:
修改类型。可选值：

version：版本改变。比如由1（投递目标为1个logstore）变为2(投递目标为2个logstore)。

config：配置改变。比如修改日志投递区域，日志存储时长等
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en:
The log version. A value of 1 indicates one Logstore. A value of 2 indicates two Logstores.


<notice>If ModifyType is set to version, set LogVersion to the target version. If ModifyType is set to config, set LogVersion to the current version of the user.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
日志版本。1:代表有1个logStore，2:代表有两个logStore。


<notice>如果ModifyType=version，则LogVersion要填写目标版本，如果ModifyType=config，则LogVersion要填写用户当前版本。></notice>
parameters.name: log_version

parameters.help_en:
The detailed configuration to modify.
<details>
<summary>Format for version 1</summary>
{"global":{"slsRegionId":"ap-southeast-1","logTime":180,"logStorage":1000}}
</details>

<details>
<summary>Format for version 2</summary>
{"cn":{"slsRegionId":"ap-southeast-1","logTime":180,"logStorage":3000},"intl":{"slsRegionId":"ap-southeast-1","logTime":180,"logStorage":2000}}
</details>
The fields are described as follows:

slsRegionId: The region ID to which logs are delivered.
logTime: The storage duration of logs. Unit: days.
logStorage: The log storage capacity. Unit: GB. The total capacity specified must not exceed the total capacity purchased by the user
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的详细的配置。
<details>
<summary>版本1的格式</summary>
{"global":{"slsRegionId":"cn-hangzhou","logTime":180,"logStorage":1000}}
</details>

<details>
<summary>版本2的格式</summary>
{"cn":{"slsRegionId":"cn-hangzhou","logTime":180,"logStorage":3000},"intl":{"slsRegionId":"ap-southeast-1","logTime":180,"logStorage":2000}}
</details>
各字段含义如下：

slsRegionId：用户投递的目标RegionId。
logTime：日志存储时长，单位（天）。
logStorage：日志存储容量，单位（GB），传入的容量之和不应大于用户购买的总容量
parameters.name: detail_config

TaskId.description_en: The task ID. Modifying log configurations is an asynchronous task. This field indicates the unique identifier of the task. You can use this ID to query the status of the task
TaskId.description_zh: 任务ID。修改日志配置为异步任务，该字段代表任务的唯一标识，后续可以用该ID查询对应任务的状态
